responsibility: This implementation module implements a pushback-capable input stream on top of FIO for scanners and parsers. It maintains a bounded character stack, current filename, line and column counters, optional character echo debugging, and warning/exit status state; it reads characters while normalizing CR handling, supports pushing back single characters or whole strings, and emits contextual diagnostics through StdIO/StrIO and stderr. Its responsibility is source-oriented token input management, not general buffered file I/O.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file is the stateful implementation half of the PushBackInput pair: unlike PushBackInput.def, it defines the bounded pushback stack, current file and source-position tracking, CR/LF handling, debug echoing, and stderr-based error/warning emission.
